chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Abu al-Abbas, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) secluded himself (in the mosque) during the month of Ramadan in the first ten days. Then he secluded himself in the second year during the middle ten days. Then he secluded himself in the third year during the last ten days. Then he did not cease to seclude himself during the last ten days.

key_terms.اعْتَكََفَ: Secluded himself (in a mosque for worship)

ai.seo_question: What was the Prophet's practice regarding I'tikaf during the different parts of Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi outlines the historical evolution of the Prophet’s I'tikaf practice, demonstrating a gradual consolidation from the first and middle ten days to a permanent establishment in the final ten days of Ramadan. In Shia scholarship, this progression is often viewed as a practical precedent (sunnah) that underscores the spiritual significance of the last decade, particularly in preparation for Laylat al-Qadr. It serves as a foundational text for the jurisprudential ruling that I'tikaf is a recommended act (mustahabb) with specific temporal boundaries.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Dawood Bin Al Husayn, from Abu Al Abbas, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> secluded himself<sup>saww</sup> in a Month of Ramazan during the first ten. Then he<sup>saww</sup> secluded in the second year, during the middle ten, then secluded in the third year during the last ten. Then he<sup>saww</sup> did not cease to seclude during the last ten (every year)’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Dawud ibn al-Huseen from abu al-‘Abbas who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, performed Ttikaf in the first ten days of the month of Ramadan. In the second year it was in the second ten days and then in the third year in the last ten days of the month of Ramadan. Thereafter it was all the time in the last ten days of the month of Ramadan.’”
